reason: B answers my clinic-owner buying doubts more directly: it identifies the manual scheduling work, explains consent and contact limits, and demonstrates how a second patient fills the slot without bothering the whole waitlist. Its patient route provides practical verification advice, and its unavailable-booking dialog at least responds clearly; I would reconsider A if its booking repeat produced an honest useful response and its workflow explanation were shorter.
